reason: At the end of the day, an AI chatbot doesn't actually care about me or understand my feelings the way a human therapist would. I can't justify paying monthly for simulated empathy when what I really need is genuine professional support.
objection: AI can't replace a real human therapist who actually cares.
would_change_my_mind: Clear clinical backing showing it genuinely helps bridge waitlists until a human therapist is available.
